title: Liabut: a lexical-phylogenetic study of how Timor's Austronesian languages branch, with a pre-registered core
description: Data, code, protocol and results for a pre-registered computational test of two disputed placements in the Austronesian languages of Timor (Lakalei-Idate and Welaun), with a second round of analyses declared after a mock referee report. Data keep their sources' licences; code is MIT-licensed.
